HAVEN-FSK LDPC(192,96) encoder mapping
Generated from the reference implementation (tools/spec_artifacts).

Message bits are the 96 bits of a 12-byte block, MSB first within
each byte (message bit index = byte_index*8 + (7 - bit_in_byte)).
Codeword positions 0..191 are in transmitted order (before the
payload interleaver, spec section 5.6).

SECTION 1 - systematic positions
MSG_POSITION[k] = codeword position carrying message bit k verbatim.
A decoder recovers the message by reading these 96 positions.

SECTION 2 - full mapping
For each codeword position p: 'M k' means it carries message bit k;
'P k1^k2^...' means it is the XOR (GF(2) sum) of those message bits.
